TERMS & CONDITIONS
(For Empanelment of Guest Faculty in CTAE, MPUAT, Udaipur)
The empanelment of the guest faculty members shall be executed on the following terms &
conditions:
1. For smooth conduction of the departmental programmes, the empanelment of the Guest
Faculty members shall be made on purely temporary basis for the academic session
2026-2027 only or up to the regular appointment of the faculty members, whichever is
earlier. No separate order shall be issued to discontinue the empanelment.
2. The empaneled guest faculty members shall not have any right to claim any kind of
regular appointment in the University on the basis of this empanelment.
3. The guest faculty members, if applied for the teaching positions, will be treated as fresh
candidate at the time of regular recruitment. The guest faculty members hereby
undertake not to make any such claim of permanency or regularization or extension of
his/her empanelment and/or a claim to treat him/her for being a regular employee
consequent upon this empanelment.
4. The guest faculty members shall be engaged on purely temporary basis subject to his /
her satisfactory performance in whole period of academic session and administrative
assignments given during the empaneled period. In case of performance of any
empaneled guest faculty is found unsatisfactory, the empanelment shall be discontinued
immediately without giving any prior notice.
5. The guest faculty members shall not be entitled for any kind of leave except University
/ Gazetted holidays.
6. If any information/document furnished is/are found to be false/incorrect, the
empanelment will be discontinued with immediate effect without giving any prior
notice.
7. The empanelled Guest faculty member will be intimated by concern Head of the
Department/Unit incharge for engagement of classes and he/she has to report his/her
duties on or before the date as decided by the College, failing which another candidate
will be given chance for engagement of classes.
8. The guest faculty members shall be bound to act in conformity with rules of the
University & college as well as a code of professional ethics as may be formulated by
the AICTE / UGC/ICAR.
9. Any empaneled guest faculty teacher found to be involved in malpractices or guilty of
misconduct or misdemean or shall be debarred and punished as per the rules.
10. As per resolution No. MPUAT/BOM-59/2022-03/02 of the Board of Management,
MPUAT and Registrar, MPUAT letter no. BOM-59/MPUAT/Meeting/2023/3554-57
dated 7/6/2023, the honorarium for Guest teacher under SFS courses shall be paid Rs.
800/- (Rupees Eight Hundred only) per Lecture (one hour) and Rs. 800/- (Rupees Eight
Hundred only) per Lab as One session (duration: 2h/3h), with the limit capping of
maximum Rs. 45,000/- per month.
Page 3 of 10
11. The said remunerations, as mentioned above, do not attract any dearness allowances or
any other allowances or perks over and above such specified remuneration.
12. In addition to academic assignments, the guest faculty members have to perform other
duties and activities as assigned by the concerned Department and College from time to
time without any additional remuneration.
13. The guest faculty members shall have no right to receive any employee benefits
including health and accident insurance, life insurance, sick-leave, CCL and/or
vacation, etc. The guest faculty members shall have to pay all taxes due in respect of
the remuneration.
14. The Guest Faculty will not be given the benefit of allowances, pension, gratuity and
leave, etc. as admissible to the regularly appointed teachers.
15. The payment of taxes including the Income Tax will be the Sole responsibility of the
guest faculty him/herself only. However, tax deduction at source (TDS) will be affected
against the payable remuneration at applicable rates as per the prevailing laws, rules
and regulations.
16. The eligible Academic Record shall be applicable as under for this empanelment
process:
a. For Engineering/Science: Minimum 60% marks (First Division) at UG level or
PG level,
b. Relaxation of 5% shall be allowed to SC/ST and differently-abled categories.
17. An empaneled guest faculty has to ensure his/her availability in the concerned
Department/College full time during College/Department working hours.
18. One month’s notice period shall be required, if any guest faculty is willing to stop the
engagement of classes at CTAE, Udaipur as guest faculty, failing which the last months
remuneration of the guest faculty shall not be paid by the college.
19. In case any guest faculty remains on leave, the same should be reported to the concern
Head of the Department via a formal application/email.
20. During the University/College Theory examination’s invigilation duty, it shall be
considered as One Lab session and accordingly remuneration will be calculated at the
concerned department. However, the guest faculty shall not be paid any additional
honorarium by the college/ university in this regard.
21. For claiming the service experience for the Guest faculty empanelment process of the
college, the applicants shall be required to submit a valid proof of experience along
with Form-16 for each year of the experience claimed.
22. The empaneled guest faculty shall be required to submit an affidavit and undertaking on
non-judicial stamp paper of Rs. 100/- duly notarized at the time of reporting for the
duties as Empanelled Guest Faculty.

CRITERIA FOR QUALIFICATION AND ELIGIBILITY
(For Empanelment of Guest Faculty in CTAE, MPUAT)
Criteria for Qualification and eligibility for empanelment of guest faculty in various branches
of Engineering and Basic Science at College of Technology and Engineering, MPUAT,
Udaipur are as follow:
Qualifications:
Posts of Humanities and Sciences in the faculty of Engineering:
Essential:
Master's Degree in the relevant subject with at least 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a
point scale wherever grading system is followed) from an Indian University or an equivalent
degree from a recognized foreign university.
Desirable:
Ph.D. and NET in relevant Discipline
For the posts of Engineering / Technology disciplines in the faculty of Engineering:
B.E./B.Tech. and M.E./M.Tech. or Integrated M. Tech. in relevant branch with first class or
equivalent in any one of the degrees.
*If suitable candidates having M.Tech. is/are not available in the interview than
candidates having B.E./B.Tech can be engaged as guest faculty to manage the classes with
due permission of the Dean, CTAE, Udaipur.
Note: A relaxation of 5% marks in the essential qualification for the post will be provided to
SC/ST/PWD category candidates.

I solemnly declare that all the information furnished by me in this application are true and

information furnished by me is found false or incorrect, my candidature as Guest faculty is liable
to be terminated at any stage of empanelment without any prior notice.
I have read and understood all the relevant information, terms and conditions, and I shall
abide by the same as also any other ordinances, statutes, rules and regulations that may be made
by the Institute (CTAE, Udaipur) hereafter. I also understand that it is a temporary arrangement
on need basis and do not have any legal right for continuation and I shall not demand for any
appointment letter.
It is also declared and certified that I have not been convicted by a court of Law for any
offence and no criminal case is pending against me in any court of Law. I have not indulged in
any of the acts of misconduct such as participating in Gherao of any educational authority,
whether academic or administrative, manhandling or abusing such authority or damaging any
building or other property. I have not been found to have used unfair means in any examination
and have not gravely misbehaved with a teacher or found to have tampered with or for geda
